findings.issue: Dev Caddyfile lacks static asset caching rules present in prod Caddyfile.prod
findings.impact: Static assets in dev not cached with immutable headers, but may cause minor difference vs prod behavior
findings.fix: Add @static handle to dev Caddyfile matching prod patterns for consistency

findings.issue: Dev worker healthcheck uses 'kill -0 1' instead of proper HTTP health check like prod
findings.impact: Dev healthcheck only checks process existence, not actual worker readiness; misses Redis connectivity failures
findings.fix: Replace with proper HTTP health check: test: ['CMD', 'wget', '-q', '--spider', 'http://localhost:4100/healthz']

findings.issue: Dev example missing DOMAIN and ENVIRONMENT variable placeholders present in deploy scripts
findings.impact: Operators may not know DOMAIN and ENVIRONMENT variables are expected
